about.title: Dental care that feels warm, modern, and approachable
about.description: Dentime Dental Clinic is a growing clinic focused on making quality dental care easier to access and more comfortable to experience.
highlights: Personalized dental care in a clean, welcoming clinic environment.
Professional support for routine care, smile enhancement, and more advanced treatment needs.
A growing practice preparing to serve more communities through branch expansion.

servicesPage.title: Comprehensive dental treatments for preventive care, braces, restorations, surgery, and pediatric visits
servicesPage.description: Dentime Dental Clinic offers these updated dental treatments across both active branches.

serviceHighlights.description: Routine care focused on keeping teeth and gums healthy before bigger problems start.
Bracket systems for alignment correction and long-term smile improvement.
Imaging support that helps the clinic assess concerns and plan treatment clearly.
Replacement and repair options for damaged or missing teeth.
items: Fixed Partial Denture (Crown, Bridge, Inlay and Onlay)

serviceHighlights.description: Care for infected or injured tooth structures that need internal treatment.
Smile enhancement and tooth repair services for function and appearance.
Extraction and minor surgical procedures for problematic teeth.
Dental care tailored for children, from prevention to restorative treatment.

locationsPage.title: Visit Dentime at the branch nearest to you
locationsPage.description: Dentime is currently serving patients through its active clinic branches.

contactPage.title: Reach the clinic through call or social media
contactPage.description: Dentime currently accommodates patients through regular scheduled appointments and walk-ins. You may also follow the clinic through its social channels for updates and inquiries.

appointmentPage.title: Send your appointment request
appointmentPage.description: Guests can request an appointment here even if they are not yet official clinic patients. Once the clinic confirms your schedule, a confirmation email will be sent to you automatically.
appointmentPage.formDescription: Required fields should match the same patient registration details used by the clinic.
appointmentPage.procedureHelperText: For all other procedures, please book a consultation first so the dentist can assess the best treatment plan for you.
appointmentPage.notesHelperText: You may leave this blank if you only want to reserve a consultation slot.
steps: Choose the branch that is most convenient for you.
Prepare your name, contact number, email address, and preferred visit schedule.
Send your request and wait for clinic confirmation.
Visit the clinic for your consultation or scheduled appointment.
